why: Hardcodes the base movement speed (3 units/s) in place of the `speed` parameter, so a slower tank's probe over-states how far it actually travels in `ticks` ticks -- the exact silent-difficulty-change shape a dropped parameter takes. Killed by targeting.test.ts's 'scales its reach with the speed it is handed, not with a hardcoded one', whose slow-tank (0.2 units/s) case is built specifically so the hardcoded fast-tank reach (3 units/s) reports a wall in reach that the real, slower tank could never touch within the same tick count.
killedBy: wallBlocksPath (issue #224) scales its reach with the speed it is handed, not with a hardcoded one
